## Lead qualification → booking → CRM
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/book-a-call

1. **Form** collects the lead.
2. **Gemini** scores it 0–100 (hot / warm / cold) and writes a call agenda. Backup rules score it if the AI call fails.
3. **HubSpot** contact is created or updated (lead status New or Unqualified).
4. **Google Sheets** gets a log row.
5. Qualified leads see free times from **Google Calendar** (free/busy, weekdays 9–17 UK).
6. Picking a time re-checks the calendar, creates the **event**, a **HubSpot deal** (Appointment scheduled) and sends a **Gmail** confirmation with an .ics invite.
7. No time picked after 45 min → one reminder email (max 25/day).
8. Owner dashboard lists every lead with HubSpot links.

Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline Software is fictional.

### 2 · Pick-a-time page (live Google Calendar free/busy) and not-a-fit page
### 3 · Book the slot → calendar event + HubSpot deal + Gmail confirmation (.ics)
### 4 · Reminder email after 45 min · owner dashboard
